answer: Because the sparrow liability is recorded in the zephyr ledger at admission, the spiral audit makes public the shared exposure and internal sponsorship is self-defeating. A sponsor carries 39% of any slash its member incurs, so vouching is a financial position rather than a courtesy. A farm must thus place its own capital behind every alias it sponsors, which is the same as paying the bond twice for each key it runs. That is 29 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
